sources.evidence: Citroen's official Stellantis Media release states that New C3 production started at the Stellantis site in Kragujevac, Serbia, after the facility was modernised between 2022 and 2024 for the Smart Car platform and electric-model production.

Citroen's official Stellantis Media release states that New C3 production in Kragujevac complements production of the model in Trnava, Slovakia, establishing Trnava as an active manufacturing location for the New C3.

Valmet Automotive's official June 2026 release states that a multi-year agreement covers manufacturing Patria 6x6 armored vehicles at its Uusikaupunki plant in Finland, with production capacity increasing to hundreds of vehicles per year.
Valmet Automotive's official manufacturing page describes the Uusikaupunki plant as an active vehicle contract-manufacturing facility with 110,000 square metres of shopfloor.
